_meta.description: Proposed test-design cases (Contract-Fixtures.md's own framing) — not executed fixtures or passing results. Symbolic message/chunk labels only; do not read these as prescribing concrete wire-field names or generated IDs.
_meta.provider: deterministic fake provider double; fails the test if a no-model operation calls it

cases.description: Distinct identities with identical content remain distinct; replay is idempotent

operations.note: identical replay of the same batch

expected_result: first call: two distinct message IDs, ordered sequences
second call: original receipt returned, replayed=true, no new write
cases.expected_persistent_changes: exactly two messages committed, from the first call only

cases.description: Idempotency-key reuse with changed content raises IdempotencyConflict, checked before any per-message MessageConflict

operations.note: same key, one message content changed

cases.expected_persistent_changes: none — messages, receipt, revisions, and lexical data unchanged
cases.resolves_checklist: CHK002 — verifies IdempotencyConflict wins over MessageConflict when both conditions could apply to the same batch

cases.description: A new batch key with a per-message identity conflict rejects the complete batch, including unrelated new messages in it

operations.note: new key; u-1 already exists with different content

cases.expected_persistent_changes: none — u-3 is not committed even though it has no conflict of its own

cases.description: Without external IDs, a new batch key never deduplicates content
cases.expected_persistent_changes: 4 total messages after all three calls

cases.description: Source identity participates in message identity — same external_id from two different sources are both retained
cases.expected_result: both messages remain, as distinct identities
cases.expected_persistent_changes: 2 messages total, identity keyed on (history_id, source_id, external_id)

cases.description: Invalid records and oversize batches are rejected as a complete batch, indexed, before any accepted prefix commits

operations.note: separately, exceed the configured 1,000-message or 8-MiB batch limit, or a single record over 256 KiB

cases.expected_result: InputValidationError in both cases, with the failing record indexed in the error
cases.expected_persistent_changes: none — no accepted prefix of either batch commits; a rejected batch is not readable through get_messages() or discoverable via search()

cross_cutting_check: For every rejected batch (I3, I6): read raw records and search for the proposed new text — neither path may expose it. Reopen after successful ingestion (I1, I4, I5) and compare original strings and IDs exactly (AT-01).
